set.body: Part of Epic bd-01KWZ2GPT8TQV4J75CBXYKHT0S. Scope: strengthen least-squares tests with an independent test-only oracle or fixture-backed reference rather than relying on OLS to validate LSS and related paths. Include adversarial/ill-conditioned and metamorphic cases. Acceptance: oracle tests fail for plausible solver regressions; JVM+JS coverage is added where portable; fixture or reference generation is documented if external.
set.title: LS hardening: add independent numerical oracle tests
